events.name: Overnight oats (LF) with chia & berries
instructions: Mix oats, chia, and milk in a jar.

events.name: Chicken & avocado lettuce cups
instructions: Mash avocado with lemon and oil.

events.name: Air-fryer salmon + veg tray
instructions: Toss veg with 1 tsp oil + garlic; air-fry 8–10 min.
Add salmon brushed with 1 tsp oil; cook 7–9 min to 145°F.

events.name: Rice cake + PB + sliced banana
instructions: Spread PB on cakes; add banana slices.

events.name: Turkey & spinach wrap (soft)
instructions: Spread LF cream cheese; layer turkey + spinach; roll.

events.name: Air‑fryer chicken bites (light panko)
instructions: Mist basket; air‑fry 380°F 10–12 min, shake once.

events.name: Egg scramble (1 egg + whites) & toast
instructions: Heat oil; scramble eggs with spinach.

events.name: Carrot‑ginger puree (microwave)
instructions: Blend carrots with milk & ginger until smooth.

events.name: Turkey chili (low‑Na, crock‑pot)
instructions: Combine in crock‑pot; LOW 4–6 h or HIGH 2–3 h.

events.name: Warm cinnamon oats (LF)
instructions: Microwave oats & milk 2–3 min; stir in cinnamon.

events.name: Protein overnight chia (LF)
instructions: Mix, cover, chill 4+ h; stir before serving.

events.name: Air‑fryer turkey meatballs + veg
instructions: Mix turkey, panko, egg; form balls.

events.name: Oatmeal (LF) + blueberries
instructions: Microwave oats & milk 2–3 min; fold berries.

instructions: Simmer egg 6–7 min; cool; peel; serve with toast.

events.name: Canned chicken salad wraps
instructions: Mix chicken + LF mayo; fill lettuce cups.

events.name: Air‑fryer cod + potatoes (soft)
instructions: Microwave potatoes 4–5 min; toss with oil.

events.name: Cinnamon rice pudding (LF)
instructions: Simmer rice with milk 3–4 min; add cinnamon.

events.name: Soft banana + PB wrap
instructions: Spread PB; add banana; roll up.

instructions: Pierce; microwave 6–8 min; split; top cottage.

events.name: Turkey skillet (single burner)
instructions: Brown turkey with oil; add veg; sauté hot.

events.name: Bean & rice bowl (microwave)
instructions: Microwave rice; fold warmed beans, oil, lime.

instructions: Toss veg with oil; air‑fry 380°F 8–10 min; add chicken 8–10 min to 165°F.

events.name: Overnight oats (LF) with banana & flax
instructions: Combine oats, milk, flax; chill; top with banana.

instructions: Air‑fry/bake cod until flaky; mash avocado; assemble tacos.

events.name: Tomato soup + toast soldiers
instructions: Heat soup; toast bread; cut into strips.

instructions: Toss veg with oil + garlic; bake/air‑fry; add turkey in small patties until 165°F.

events.name: Soft egg & spinach wrap
instructions: Scramble egg + whites with spinach; wrap in tortilla.

events.name: Chicken quinoa bowl (microwave)
instructions: Microwave rice + veg; toss with chicken + oil.

events.name: Hummus + cucumber boats
instructions: Scoop channels in cucumbers; fill with hummus.

instructions: Microwave potatoes soft; mash lightly with 1 tsp oil.
Air‑fry salmon 380°F 7–9 min; serve with mash.

events.name: Overnight oats + pear & chia
instructions: Mix oats, chia, milk; chill; add pear.

events.name: Turkey & tomato soft melt
instructions: Layer turkey + tomato; top with mozzarella; warm until cheese softens.

instructions: Form small patties; air‑fry 380°F 8–10 min; veg alongside.

events.name: Chia pudding (LF) + blueberries
instructions: Mix chia + milk; chill 4 h; add berries.

events.name: Tuna & avocado lettuce wraps
instructions: Mash avocado with tuna + lemon; fill wraps.

events.name: Turkey meatballs in tomato (low‑Na)
instructions: Mix turkey + panko + egg; brown or air‑fry; warm in tomato soup.

events.name: Oats‑cocoa bedtime cup (LF)
instructions: Microwave oats + milk; whisk in cocoa.

events.name: Chicken & rice bowl (microwave)
instructions: Microwave rice + veg; toss with chicken + oil.

events.name: Tomato soup + LF cheese toast
instructions: Melt cheese on toast; serve with soup.

instructions: Toss cod cubes with 1 tsp oil; air‑fry 380°F 7–9 min; veg alongside.

events.name: Cinnamon milk (LF) + oats dust
instructions: Warm milk; whisk in oats + cinnamon.

events.name: Overnight oats + mango (LF)
instructions: Mix oats + milk; chill; top with mango.

events.name: Turkey & avocado bowls
instructions: Microwave rice; top with turkey + avocado.

events.name: Hummus + steamed carrots
instructions: Steam carrots very soft; dip in hummus.

instructions: Sauté veg in 1 tsp oil; add salmon cubes with 1 tsp oil; cook until flaky.

events.name: Chia‑oat cup (LF) + berries
instructions: Mix oats, chia, milk; chill; top with berries.

events.name: Rice cake + almond slivers + honey
instructions: Top rice cakes; drizzle a little honey.

events.name: Chicken & tomato soft bowl
instructions: Microwave rice; warm tomatoes; toss with chicken.

events.name: Air‑fryer fish & veg tray (cod)
instructions: Toss veg with oil; air‑fry 380°F 8–10 min; add cod 7–9 min.

events.name: Cinnamon milk (LF) nightcap
instructions: Warm milk; whisk in cinnamon + a touch of honey.
